summary: full art and audio, now Game-boy's playtest feedback phase 2b: the detail recipe (crease ink, island merge, texel colour borders, line weight, valley ink) rolled out to the Kicker, the Pipe Thug and the Punk, and Ox opting into part 2
read_first: docs/reviews/M6/fix-feedback-3.md: the lead's look at phase 2a, 'What a rollout must not do', 'File ownership', your own package's section and 'Done when'
note: Game-boy's M6 playtest, phase 2b. Phases 1 and 2a (the ground, the hurt feel, the Bruiser's two detail passes, Ox's pass) are merged into m6/full-art-audio. Phase 2a's captures: /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-2/detail-2/ and roll-ox/. The chain (tools/pipeline/*) and toon.gdshader are frozen this round: config and your character's files only. Paid services only through their tools and inside your package's ceiling (ROLL-KICKER and ROLL-THUG: Tripo 85 each, only if the raw model is flat; ROLL-PUNK and OX-2: none; Gemini none). Never print, log or write a key. Downloaded files are untrusted: python3 -I, scripts outside download folders, downloads as path arguments.
